subject: Consistent finishes across a commercial interior
hook: Reception desks, storage and staff areas made in one consistent finish.
gbp:
Commercial furniture made in one consistent finish.

When a reception desk, office storage and staff areas come from different suppliers, the finishes rarely match. We design and make commercial furniture as one joined-up job, so every piece in your building shares the same board decor, edging and handles.

Who it's for: offices, salons, clinics, showrooms and other businesses planning a fit-out, a refurbishment, or new furniture that has to sit alongside what's already there.

What we make:
- Reception desks and counters
- Office storage, filing and staff lockers
- Staff kitchenettes and tea points
- Meeting room and breakout storage

How it works: a free, no-obligation consultation, a measuring visit and an itemised quote with transparent pricing. We agree a finish schedule up front, from matt and super matt colours to oak-effect and black woodgrain, with antique gold or matt black handles. Everything is manufactured in our own workshop, quality-checked, then delivered and installed by our own team.

We work with businesses in Hanley and across Stoke-on-Trent. Tap Learn more to see our commercial cabinet making.
